title: 屋外コンセント盤
description: マルシェや屋台の会場、キャンプ場の区画に立つ、屋外用のコンセント盤です。コンクリートの台座、ステンレスの柱状の本体と雨よけの笠、上下2段・計4口のコンセントと開いた防水ふた、ブレーカーの窓と施錠扉、無地の定格ラベルを造形しています。電気的な機能、配線、定格表示の文字は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.450 × 1.209 × 0.450 m、1,764三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An outdoor power outlet pedestal for markets, food-stall venues and camp pitches. It models the concrete pad, stainless body with rain cap, four sockets on two levels with raised weatherproof covers, a breaker window behind a lockable door, and a blank rating label. Electrical function, wiring and rating text are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.450 × 1.209 × 0.450 m; 1,764 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
